interface.longDescription: See whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude mention and cite your brand, how you rank against competitors, which Google searches show an AI Overview, and what to fix on your pages to get cited. Pay per check on your Apify account. Includes 4 skills (ai-overview-check, ai-visibility-check, ai-visibility-cost-estimate, geo-site-audit) and Apify's hosted MCP server limited to Imzlab's Actors. After installing, run `codex mcp login ai-visibility` to sign in to Apify in the browser.
defaultPrompt: Does ChatGPT mention Notion when people ask about note-taking apps?
